title: World dialogue
idea: World dialogue: Speaker identity and readable dialogue lead timed or untimed choices
audience: People who need to choose dialogue within a game surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic conversation layout through its choose dialogue priority and explicit commitment contract: Time limits are explicit and response commits once
navigation: World dialogue keeps the current choose dialogue context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Speaker identity and readable dialogue lead timed or untimed choices
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to choose dialogue; conversation changes the story
composition.priority: Time limits are explicit and response commits once

imagery.role: Support the actual choose dialogue context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Support text speed captions and clear selected choice
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the world dialogue structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no choose dialogue content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Time limits are explicit and response commits once
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized choose dialogue content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Time limits are explicit and response commits once
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active choose dialogue context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
